title: Uniform and Lantern
author: Lena Ashgrove
blurb: Hazel Okafor, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
